notes:
New Features:

- Active long-check protection now blocks accidental channel changes while a 2 h IPTV Check or Site Check is running and restores the currently tested channel when an external Kodi/PVR change bypasses the resolver.
- 1 h and 2 h checks now offer optional PC end actions: suspend, or shutdown after copying kodi.log to the configured IPTV playlist folder.

Improvements:

- Shutdown is only executed after kodi.log has been copied successfully with a timestamped filename; if log copy fails, shutdown is cancelled.
- 15 min and 30 min checks remain unchanged and never offer PC power actions.
- 2 h Site Channels Check now allows exactly one Site and one Page at a time to prevent overly large multi-site long-check queues.

Bugfixes:

- Prevents a manually started different Adult-TV-Test IPTV channel from silently replacing the channel currently under long-duration test.
- Adds a background guard for channel changes that occur outside the Adult TV Test resolver, so an active check can recover its intended stream instead of being abandoned.
